Visual style: warm ivory paper (#f7f2e6), crisp hand-inked dark navy outlines (#18283f), flat muted teal (#75a99f) and ochre (#d6a34d) fills, very light paper grain, minimal shadows. Create a quiet, memorable header emblem with NO TEXT AT ALL. A large open navy-bound field notebook lies on an ivory surface, viewed at a gentle angle. On its open pages is a very simple diagram of branching company decisions. One ochre route runs from a tangible coin near the page edge into a small lowered barrier. Another dotted, unused teal branch leads to a key. A large navy-handled magnifying glass rests over the junction, enlarging where these routes diverge. The diagram is integrated into the notebook pages, not separate floating icons. The coin stands for investment, the blocked route for a mistaken commitment, and the unused key for a missed opportunity. Use just these few objects, a strong silhouette and generous empty ivory space around the whole composition. Book-cover quality; calm, clear, no text or numbers.
hero.alt: A magnifying glass examines investment paths in an open notebook: one meets a barrier and another leads to an unused key.

Use a very simple TWO-ROW comparison to explain a specialist delivering work without transferring the method. There must be NO ARROW suggesting that knowledge reaches the team. At the top, a complete teal three-gear mechanism with a large check mark has arrived on a company workbench. Place the large label "Result delivered" above this successful result. At the bottom, on the left, the specialist holds an open navy notebook showing the method as a small gear diagram. Label this notebook "Know-how". At the bottom right, two company colleagues stand with an EMPTY open notebook. Between the two notebooks show a VERY WIDE BREAK in a low horizontal footbridge: its left half ends abruptly, a broad ivory chasm takes up the central quarter of the composition, and its right half starts far away. Above this physical gap put the large, exact label "No handover". No arrow, rope or dotted line may cross or bridge this gap. The missing bridge is the most prominent feature in the lower row. Only these three text labels: "Result delivered", "Know-how", "No handover". No outer border. Do not add any other label or symbol of successful learning.
figures.alt: A working mechanism is delivered, but a missing bridge separates the specialist’s know-how from the company team.
figures.caption: A useful result can arrive without the knowledge the team needs to handle the next similar problem.

Draw two clean comparable horizontal work pipelines, one above the other. Show one specialist on the left and a company team of two people on the right, on opposite sides of a simple workbench. A complete teal working mechanism with three neatly meshing gears sits in the centre, with a check mark and the large label "Result delivered".
